answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive overview of **Mundra Port**:

---

### 🚢 Mundra Port – Overview

Mundra Port is the **largest commercial and container port in India**, located on the northern shores of the **Gulf of Kutch**, near Mundra, Kutch district, **Gujarat**.

It is **India's first private port**, formerly operated by Mundra Port and Special Economic Zone Limited (MPSEZ) under the ownership of the **Adani Group**. It was later expanded to become **Adani Ports & SEZ Limited (APSEZ)**, managing several port projects.

---

### 📍 Location & Connectivity

The Mundra Port is located in the **Northern Gulf of Kutch**, en route major maritime routes and connected through **rail, road, air & pipelines**.

Mundra Port in Gujarat offers direct connectivity to major global markets including the **US East Coast, Europe, Middle East, and Africa**.

---

### 📦 Cargo & Capacity

The port handles over **155 million tonnes (MT)** of cargo — the highest in India — constituting nearly **11% of India's total annual maritime cargo**, and handles nearly **33% of India's container traffic**.

The port has been designed to handle all types of cargo, including **containers, dry bulk, break bulk, liquid cargo, and automobiles**.

Mundra Port handles a variety of cargo ranging from bulk cargo like **coal, grain, fertilizer, minerals, ores, steel, edible oils, chemicals, and petroleum products** to container cargo, automobiles, and crude oil.

---

### 🏗️ Infrastructure

Mundra Port operates **26 berths** across multiple specialized terminals with a total capacity of **228 MMTPA**, including four container terminals handling **7.5 million TEUs** annually, equipped with deep-water berths up to **19 meters draft**.

It is a **deep draft, all-weather port** with state-of-the-art infrastructure and the **largest coal import terminal**, which gives faster cargo evacuation and minimal turnaround time.

The port is served by all major global shipping lines, including **Maersk, MSC, CMA CGM, Hapag-Lloyd, COSCO, and Evergreen**.

---

### 🌐 Special Economic Zone (SEZ)

The Port of Mundra is also a **Special Economic Zone (SEZ)**. It became **India's first multi-product port-based special economic zone**.

---

### 📊 Global Standing

Mundra Port ranks **among the top 30 busiest container ports globally**.

In summary, Mundra is a **major private commercial seaport** on India's west coast, owned and operated by the **Adani Group (APSEZ)**, and serves as India's largest and most strategically significant port for both domestic and international trade.
